# Error Handling Checklist: SPEC-014C First Real Harness Adapter Pilot

**Purpose**: Validate fail-closed error-handling requirement quality for the first real Codex app-server harness adapter.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are unavailable Codex binary requirements defined for command lookup failure, spawn failure, exit before valid handshake, and HAL UAT blocking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019; Spec Clarifications §Codex App-Server Protocol; Plan §Terminal Mapping]

- [x] CHK003 Are unsupported live user-input and MCP elicitation requirements required to fail closed without auto-answering? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016; Contract §Protocol Contract]
- [x] CHK004 Are unsupported command approval, file approval, dynamic tool, MCP tool, and permission request requirements defined with closed reason codes and no auto-approval? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017; Contract §Protocol Contract]
- [x] CHK005 Are unsupported capability requirements tied to the admitted manifest and capability packet instead of inferred from raw protocol payloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018; Data Model §Runtime Inventory Eligibility Decision]
- [x] CHK006 Are unsafe evidence rejection requirements defined before redaction, with redaction allowed only for secret-shaped values inside otherwise bounded safe summaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015; Spec Clarifications §Evidence, Artifacts, And Redaction]
- [x] CHK007 Are partial, missing, duplicated, or malformed usage requirements defined so Paddock records unavailable or partial usage instead of inventing metrics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013; Spec Edge Cases; Data Model §Codex App-Server Adapter Manifest]
- [x] CHK008 Are stale claim-control and ownership-loss recovery requirements defined for preparing, running, continuation, and terminal write phases? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Contract §Ownership Re-Proof Points]

## Requirement Consistency
